title: Entralink challenge
description: One challenge of the Entralink roguelike (docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-roguelike-prototype.md): the battle a room of a run holds, with the enemies that stand in the room as overworld actors. Its ID is the file's name, which run.json names it by. tools/paperwhite2/entralink_run.py checks it and writes it into paperwhite2/entralink_run_config.h.

name.description: The challenge's name, for the editor (the game doesn't show it yet)

tier.description: Its difficulty tier, for the editor and later runs' room picks

format.description: single: one enemy. double: one or two. triple: one to three. raid: exactly one, in the center of a triple battle against three of the player's Pokémon

weather.description: The battle's weather from its start (constants/battle.h); without it, the field's

moves.description: Its moves, in order, replacing the ones it has by its level

ability.description: An ABILITY_* it has whatever its species', or "hidden" for its hidden one; without it, one of its species' two

item.description: Its held item; none if left out

gender.description: As its species allows; random if left out

actor.description: Where its overworld actor stands in the room, in tiles (a room is 32 by 32; the exits are at x 15-16 z 9 and z 24, and z 15-17 x 5 and x 26), and the way it faces
